test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with appropriate prepositions.

The child prefers watching a movie ______ playing a boring video game.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**to**" is used to show preference between two actions or items.
 
• In this sentence, the child prefers watching a movie over playing a boring video game, so "**to**" is the correct choice.</
